data.one_liner: Texture atlas support for the Flame game engine using the fire atlas editor.
data.what_it_does: Flame Fire Atlas is a texture atlas library for the Flame engine. It allows developers to load fire_atlas assets into their games and extract sprites and animations by name.
use_when: You are building a game using the Flame engine and want to use texture atlases created with the Fire Atlas Editor.
You need an easy way to load sprites and animations from a single atlas asset file in Flame.
avoid_when: You are not using the Flame game engine.
Your assets are in a different sprite sheet format that is not supported by fire_atlas.
strengths: Seamless integration with the Flame engine.
Simple API to load atlases and retrieve sprites or animations by name.
weaknesses: Requires using the specific Fire Atlas Editor for creating the atlases.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and load assets using FireAtlas.loadAsset or loadFireAtlas.
